artifact_inspected: IMS demo build (VITE_DEMO production bundle) after UI/UX enhancement increment T-101..T-107: responsive shell, focus-visible tokens, honest disclosure bell, SPA-link navigation, dashboard density and data-honest movement display

defects_found.description: New Product modal overlay lacks role=dialog, so screen readers do not announce it as a dialog (works visually and closes on Escape)
Pre-existing jsPDF critical advisories (LFI/path traversal <=3.0.4; HTML injection <=4.2.0) in the reports PDF dependency; not introduced by this increment, browser-only exposure limited
8 high + 15 moderate + 3 low advisories in the same jspdf/dompurify chain
Vite build warns main chunk >500kB (pre-existing reports bundle size; demo scale unaffected - max DCL 151ms measured)
No dedicated unit tests for dashboard card derivation beyond the shared movementQuantityDisplay helper (closed as acceptable in round-2 review)

refinement_actions: Fixed all axe violations found by the evidence run (5 rule categories: sidebar contrast (slate-400), dashboard heading order (h2), unique nav landmarks, labeled report Select, visible Actions headers on all 12 action tables)
Replaced sr-only table-header fallback with visible Actions header after discovering the absolute-positioned span escaped the scroller and caused 132-205px page overflow at 375px
Corrected movement sign rendering to use unit-tested movementQuantityDisplay (released rows now show negative red)
Converted stat-card anchors to SPA Links so the memory-only demo session survives dashboard navigation
Applied sanitizeSearchTerm to the URL q parameter before ilike interpolation in finance search
Follow-ups logged: add role=dialog + focus trap to Modal; upgrade jspdf/dompurify in a dedicated dependency increment
Follow-up (nit): danger button focus ring is primary-blue via shared focus-visible token; consider variant-aware ring color from semantic tokens
Follow-up (nit): finance search term that sanitizes to empty falls back to an unfiltered query; consider showing the zero-row state when input was present but fully stripped
rating_rationale: All increment acceptance criteria verified at the live surface (19/19 browser checks, 0 axe violations, 0 console/network errors, 0 overflow at 3 viewports, token parity #2563EB computed-style match); rating held at good rather than excellent because of the open pre-existing dependency advisories and the modal dialog-semantics gap.

sources_consulted.name: W3C WAI — Understanding WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible (Level AA)
sources_consulted.purpose: Authoritative requirements for focus indicators: subject to 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast, sufficient techniques C40 (two-color indicator) and C45 (:focus-visible), and 2.4.13 Focus Appearance as the size/consistency reference

sources_consulted.name: MDN — :focus-visible CSS pseudo-class
sources_consulted.purpose: Confirmed the UA-heuristic matching semantics that drove the harness fix: programmatic .focus() generally does not trigger :focus-visible, so focus rings must be tested with real keyboard navigation

sources_consulted.name: W3C ARIA APG — Disclosure Navigation Menu example
sources_consulted.purpose: Keyboard-support and semantics baseline for collapsible navigation surfaces (aria-labelled nav, dismissal keys, focus handling) applied to the drawer and popover behavior

sources_consulted.name: Tailwind CSS — box-shadow/ring utilities documentation
sources_consulted.purpose: Implementation vehicle for the 2px focus ring (ring + ring-offset utilities) used by the focus-visible token treatment on light and dark surfaces

docs/DESIGN.md v1.0 project design artifact (token/type/density authority; outranks generic defaults per frontend skill priority)
live 3-viewport Playwright audit of the current product (prime/evidence/ui-audit/audit-findings.json)
patterns_adopted: off-canvas drawer + scrim with route-change and Escape dismissal, focus returned to the trigger (APG disclosure keyboard baseline)
horizontal scroll containment for dense data tables (min-w inside overflow-x-auto) rather than compressing columns
2px primary-500 focus-visible ring with offset on every interactive control, kept ≥3:1 against both light and dark surfaces per WCAG 1.4.11 focus-indicator contrast
real-data notification badge with capped count ('9+') and honest empty state ('All clear.')
loading skeleton -> explicit error copy -> data -> empty state for new dashboard bands
focus verification driven by real Tab key events, mirroring :focus-visible UA heuristics
local_design_decisions: sidebar state lifted into ProtectedLayout so drawer/collapse/content-margin share one source of truth (structural root-cause fix for the dead-gap class)
header search reuses the existing /finance/search page via ?q= deep link — zero new UI surface for an honest affordance
bell reuses the cached ['dashboard'] summary query (no extra request); Needs-Attention filters stockStatus client-side because the mock builder lacks .lt()
patterns_rejected: selector-suggested Dark-Mode(OLED) style and Fira Code/Fira Sans typography — contradict the approved light-only Inter theme in docs/DESIGN.md (project artifact outranks generic defaults)
rewriting tables to card lists on mobile — rejected in favor of scroll containment to preserve scanning density for operations staff
gradient avatar treatment — replaced with flat primary-600 token surface (anti-slop + token fidelity)
